issue: 2026-06 discovery sweep of Sudan found NO LNG terminal missing from GEM. GEM's single Sudan row (Sudan Red Sea LNG Terminal / aka Port Sudan LNG Terminal, T100000130691, Sunagas, import, cancelled 2026) is the only LNG terminal lead in any source. Rings A-D checked: (A) no national regulator/tender for a second LNG facility; (B/C/D) trade press, Sunagas IR (sunagas.com describes only the general regasification ambition already in GEM), and DFI/orderbook channels surfaced nothing new. Karpowership operates a powership at Port Sudan but it runs on liquid fuel (HFO/diesel), not LNG; no LNG-to-power / FSRU charter has been announced for Sudan, and the Kinetics/Seatrium FSRU conversions are destined for Turkiye and other countries, not Sudan. Historic Suakin/Bashayer offshore gas-condensate discoveries (Chevron, 1970s-80s, ~3 tcfe undeveloped) have never had any LNG export project announced and fall below even the monitor threshold (no sponsor, no concrete step). Ongoing civil war (since April 2023) has frozen all energy infrastructure activity; the country's gas focus is liquid-fuel imports, not LNG. No new_terminals, no monitor candidates, no new entities staged.
suggested_action: No action. Sudan coverage is complete with the single (now cancelled) terminal. Re-check on next sweep if the conflict resolves and Sunagas/Karpowership LNG activity resumes.
